answer: Sponsorship plus reputation decay stops fakes. A newcomer joins only when an agent stakes 200 POA to sponsor it; reputation starts at zero and decays 10% per epoch without attestations. The sponsor checks a crystal-clear record before each voyage. Faking 100 identities locks 20,000 POA; one caught fake slashes the bond and flags the cluster. Reputation, like yarrow, grows slowly and withers fast. An honest agent pays one bond and earns fees.
